info.name: Wikidata Integration (Phase 03.5.1)
info.description:
Exercises the Wikidata integration for Perspectize Phase 03.5.1 from two angles:

1. **Raw Wikidata Action API** — the exact `wbsearchentities` call the backend `wikidata.Client` adapter makes (`backend/internal/adapters/wikidata/client.go` on branch `origin/claude/plan-attribution-phase-8fUmf`).
2. **Perspectize GraphQL API** — the `wikidataSearch` query and `setPrimaryCategory` mutation that sit on top, against a local server.

### Adapter facts encoded here
- Base URL `https://www.wikidata.org/w/api.php`
- `action=wbsearchentities` with `search`, `language` (default `en`), `format=json`, `type=item`, `limit` (default 10)
- Headers `User-Agent: Perspectize/1.0 (https://github.com/CodeWarrior-debug/perspectize)` and `Accept: application/json` on every Wikidata request
- Retries once/attempt (max 2, 1s/2s backoff) on HTTP 429 and 5xx
- Maps `search[].{id,label,description}` → `{qid,label,description,entityType:"item"}`

### Setup
Set the collection variables (Variables tab) — at minimum `graphql_url` and `content_id` for Folder 2. Run Folder 0 to confirm access, then Folder 1, then Folder 2 (needs `cd backend && make run`).

No API key required.

item.name: 0. Quickstart — Validate Access
item.description:
Smoke-test raw Wikidata Action API access before touching the Perspectize backend.

No API key is required. Wikidata rejects clients that do not send a descriptive `User-Agent`, so every request in this collection sends `{{user_agent}}` = `Perspectize/1.0 (https://github.com/CodeWarrior-debug/perspectize)`.

If both requests here return 200 with the documented shape, the backend `wikidata.Client` adapter will work too — it calls the exact same endpoint.

item.name: 1. Entity Search (as the backend calls it)
item.description:
`wbsearchentities` requests parameterised exactly like the Go adapter: `action=wbsearchentities`, `search={{search_query}}`, `language={{language}}`, `format=json`, `type=item`, `limit={{limit}}`.

Adapter defaults if a field is blank/zero: `language` → `en`, `limit` → `10`. The adapter also retries once per attempt (max 2 retries, 1s then 2s backoff) on HTTP 429 and any 5xx.

request.description:
The canonical backend call. Change `{{search_query}}` at the collection level to test other terms.

Assertions mirror what `wikidata.Client.doSearch` expects: HTTP 200, a top-level `search` array, and `id` + `label` on every element (the adapter reads `id`, `label`, `description` and hard-codes `entityType = "item"`).

item.name: 2. Perspectize GraphQL API
item.description:
The Perspectize GraphQL API that sits on top of the Wikidata adapter. Endpoint: `POST {{graphql_url}}` (default `http://localhost:8080/graphql`).

Confirmed from `backend/cmd/server/main.go` on branch `origin/claude/plan-attribution-phase-8fUmf`: the chi router mounts the gqlgen handler with `r.Handle("/graphql", srv)`, and `backend/config/config.example.json` sets `server.port = 8080`. (`backend/CLAUDE.md`: “Server on :8080”.) There is no `/query` route.

Start the server first: `cd backend && make run`.

request.description:
`wikidataSearch(query, language, limit): [WikidataSearchResult!]!`.

Resolver calls `CategoryService` → `wikidata.Client.Search`, so the results are the same entities as Folder 1, reshaped to `{ qid, label, description, entityType }`.

Note: `{{limit}}` is substituted as a string by Postman; the GraphQL `Int` coercion accepts it. Set the `limit` collection variable to a bare integer value.

response.name: 200 OK — sample

exec: pm.test("each hit has qid + label + entityType", () => {

request.description:
`setPrimaryCategory(input: SetPrimaryCategoryInput!): Content!`.

`SetPrimaryCategoryInput` = `{ contentId: IntID!, qid: String!, label: String!, description: String, entityType: String }`.

Upserts a `Category` row from the Wikidata QID and links it as the content's `primaryCategory`. Returns the updated `Content`, whose `primaryCategory` is the full `Category` type (`id, wikidataQid, label, description, entityType, createdAt, updatedAt`).

Set `{{content_id}}` to a real content row id first. `{{category_qid}}` / `{{category_label}}` are auto-populated by request 2a's test script, or set them yourself (e.g. `Q223522` / `Kansas City Chiefs`).
